metadata.boundary: Exclusive disposable non-production runtime surface for T003 cutover-readiness rehearsal. It may expose a blank virtual block device and disposable restore scratch only after fresh evidence proves that the backing target is not the productive Heim-PC root/system disk, not any mounted production filesystem and not production EFI/firmware state. The sandbox may consume independent off-host backup material read-only for restore testing but grants no production-device write authority.
does_not_establish: production EFI or firmware mutation authority
production NixOS install or activation authority
